note: Cast-color button labels — the wiring spec for iOS / Android / web (see README.md).

rules.fit: Label area = the flat middle only, inset from each end by max(capInset × height, minPad). Shrink the font from fontOfHeight × height down to minFontPt; if it still does not fit, the button grows wider. Text never touches the caps.
rules.strokeAndShadow: Stroke = the deeper SAME-hue color below (one outline, drawn under the white fill; no grey, no white edge, no second offset outline). Shadow = the same color, soft drop.
